summary: Frontend-only test of the backend-served upgraded admin console at /api/admin/ui. All UI wiring works end-to-end with admin token 'jobby-admin-7c2f9a': page loads (HTTP 200, title 'JOBBY · Admin'), Connect flow authenticates and flips the badge to 'connected', Dashboard shows the new 'Revenue monitoring' section (Revenue €15.6, GMV €119.6, Top-ups €0, Payments vol €0) and 'Operations' section (Users 12, Clients 3, Providers 9, Online 9, Pending approvals 0, Missions 10, Bookings 3, Completed 3, Payments 0, Categories 20/29). Users tab lists all users with role/status pills; provider & business rows expose Approve/Suspend/Reject buttons while client rows show 'auto'. Suspend on Francesco Franzin (user_2f996c8a010a, business) flipped the status pill approved->suspended, then Approve returned it to approved (verified via GET /api/admin/users: approval_status='approved'). Filter chips (All/Pending/Providers/Business/Clients) filter the list correctly (Clients chip hides Approve buttons; Pending chip shows only pending rows). Categories tab renders 29 toggles grouped by Standard/Proximity/Payment. Bookings tab renders a table with 3 rows. Standalone /app/admin-web folder still contains index.html, netlify.toml, README.md.
critical_code_review_comments: admin_web.py:225 uses window.confirm() for Suspend/Reject; in headless browsers this requires a dialog handler. Not a bug for production UX (admin acknowledges intent) — just noting it caused a first-pass test miss.

The token input is type='password' and auto-restored from localStorage on load, which is fine, but there is no visible 'Disconnect/Logout' control to clear the stored admin token from a shared browser.
seed_data_creation: None. Francesco Franzin (user_2f996c8a010a) was toggled suspended->approved during the test and left in approval_status='approved' as required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin console lives at GET /api/admin/ui (server-rendered HTML, not Expo). Auth = X-Admin-Token header, token 'jobby-admin-7c2f9a' entered in #token input then Connect. Standalone Netlify build remains at /app/admin-web (index.html/netlify.toml/README.md). Note the Users tab renders two users containing the substring 'Francesco': 'Fra Fra (FraFra)' (client, no actions) and 'Francesco Franzin' (business, actions). Filter by exact text 'Francesco Franzin' to target the business row for status toggles. Suspend/Reject trigger a window.confirm() — register a dialog handler that accepts before clicking.
